title: An archive of animations uploaded from the app
summary: Open one ZIP on the phone, list all entries, select all eligible ODRG/ODRGX animations or a subset, and upload their original bytes sequentially to an explicit Internal or External destination captured from the explored folder. Show selection-dependent projected use/free/capacity with staging and metadata headroom, resolve collisions without default overwrite, bound archive handling, and reconcile partial or uncertain outcomes. Reuse managed upload protections; missing folders depend on the separate storage explorer work and unsupported guarded replacements remain blocked. Planning only; no new command is authorized.
